chunks: Ali (ibn al-Hakam) from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the menstruating woman: does she pray behind the Imam for the funeral? He said, 'Yes, and she does not stand with them; she stands alone.'

key_terms.تُصَلِّي عَلَى الْجَنَازَةِ: Praying behind the Imam for the funeral

ai.seo_question: Does a menstruating woman pray behind the Imam in the funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of menstruation in ritual prayer, distinguishing between the validity of the act and the conditions of congregation. It establishes that while a menstruating woman is exempt from the full ritual purity required for standing in rows with the Imam, her presence and individual performance of the funeral prayer remain legally valid, reflecting the Shia view that menstruation does not invalidate the prayer itself but affects its communal configuration.
